{{Top}}
[[File:Merchant_Tent_CotF.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A merchant selling from a tent on Tatooine]]
'''Merchants''', also called '''traders''', were people who sold and bought various products. Although some merchants did business legally, many did business illegally. Traders could also be adept at constructing a number of goods, including weapons, furniture, and droids. Traders who took part in constructing goods would occasionally specialize in a specific field, such as munitions, structures, domestic goods, or [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', merchants were a playable profession prior to the New Game Enhancements of [[2005]]. After the changes, the merchant profession was removed, and merged with the newly created trader profession. In the game, traders were the basis of most of the in-game economy.
